name: Plugin Manager
author: Brett
description: Every console plugin in one place: info, health, enable / disable, logs, settings, its UI, install & uninstall, and its dependencies in detail (what it needs, who provides it, who needs it, what clashes). Four views (cards, table, detail, dependency graph) in four completely different layouts (Studio, Mission control, Terminal, Catalog). Opened from the default context menu, the Plugins nav section or Settings → Plugins → Plugin Manager.
